lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This country is lower than the sea right next to it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So how is it still dry?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meet the Netherlands, by the North Sea.

lines.speaker: netherlands
lines.text: Hallo! Much of my land lies below sea level.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the North Sea never stops pushing.

lines.speaker: netherlands
lines.text: Uh oh... the water is coming!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ...and held back the sea, one wall at a time.

lines.speaker: netherlands
lines.text: We fight the sea. And we win!
